name: JAMAL MOHAMED MUZAMMIL
professional_summary: SAP Certified Data Analyst Associate with 3.9 years of experience in ETL and analytical tools, delivering high-quality, business-driven solutions. Passionate about leveraging innovative technologies to solve complex problems and eager to contribute to a dynamic team while continuing to grow in SAP.

professional_experience.title: Packaged Development Analyst
professional_experience.description: SAP Datasphere Expert with 3 years of experience in end-to-end implementations, creating Views, Analytical Models, Data Flows, Replication Flows, and Task Chains. Skilled in data ingestion via both Data Federation and Replication, replicating delta-enabled CDS views from SAP S/4HANA for real-time analytics and utilizing HANA functions for currency/unit conversions and complex business logic. Strong in security and governance, implementing Data Access Controls (DAC) for row-level security and managing roles, database users, OAuth2.0, and integration connections. Hands-on with SAC and ABAP CDS, building dashboards and visualizations in SAP Analytics Cloud, and developing CDS views using ADT in Eclipse for analytics and reporting. Good exposure with Non-SAP modelling and visualization tools like Qlik Compose, Denodo, Data Mart and Power BI. Collaborative and proactive, worked closely with functional teams, mentored junior members, and maintained technical documentation to ensure scalable, clean, and optimized solutions following SAP best practices. Proficient in SAP Datasphere development including admin activities. Knowledge of SAP FI and SD functional module. Familiar with SAP Analytics Cloud Stories and Core Data Services (CDS).

professional_experience.title: Associate Development Engineer
professional_experience.description: Built SAC dashboards for various business areas: Recruitment, MM, Procurement, Finance and Plant Maintenance. Utilized Story Filters, Page Filters, Input Controls, and Dynamic Texts to create interactive and user-friendly dashboards. Implemented Calculated Measures and Restricted Key Figures within SAC stories for customized business metrics. Worked with SAC Planning — created planning models, data locking, and scenarios. Integrated SAC with live and import connections, scheduled imports, and used performance optimization techniques. Built Multi-Model Dashboards by blending data from various sources (Datasphere, HANA, BW, Excel)
